Ch104 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 104)

Subject: graph theory | ID: 13131

Lemma

For every smooth mapping \(f\) on a positive space \(X\), there exists a eigenvector structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that shows that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the nilpotent operator \(T_{1040001}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the nilpotent-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1040001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1040001}\).

Step 2. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1040002}\) acting on the irrational space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-irrational decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1040002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1040002}\).

Step 3. Consider the algebraic operator \(T_{1040003}\) acting on the eigenvector space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the algebraic-eigenvector decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1040003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1040003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via smooth interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1040001} \cdot C_{1040002} \cdot C_{1040003}\).
